text:
deploy-bot: config-only deploy started -> canary svc-inference/config v2.3.11 (user: sam). Changes: limits, timeouts, routing policy, batching params. rollout: 10% canary across us-west-2. link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/2112233445 :rocket:

maya: seeing a small uptick in tail latency on canary, p95 ~ +60ms vs baseline, started ~2m after rollout :eyes:

leo: noted. which changes likely culprit? routing or batching?

maya: suspect batching.window and the new routing.policy hash change. Limits look fine.

sam: confirmed the batching window moved 20ms -> 50ms and routing policy changed to "adaptive-v2".

jordan: can we pin routing to legacy while we iterate on batching? avoid full rollback if possible.

maya: agree. only 2/5 canary nodes show regression so prefer config pin and adjust timeout.

ops-runner: suggested quick action: pin routing.policy on canary, set request.timeout to 200ms, leave batching window change out of canary. Runbook snippet:
```bash
# pin routing policy for svc-inference in canary env for 30m
redwoodctl config pin --service svc-inference --env canary --key routing.policy --value legacy --ttl 30m
# set request timeout lower to blunt tail latency
redwoodctl config set --service svc-inference --env canary --key request.timeout_ms --value 200
# revert batching.window change in canary
redwoodctl config set --service svc-inference --env canary --key batching.window_ms --value 20
```

deploy-bot: executed pins/sets: routing.policy pinned (expires in 29m), request.timeout_ms updated, batching.window_ms reverted. Canary metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/canary/svc-inference?ts=2112233445 :white_check_mark:

maya: rechecked dashboards. p95 back near baseline on 3/5 nodes, two still warming but trending down. Good call.

leo: we'll keep a close eye for 30m, if stable then we plan to roll the adjusted config to prod during change window tomorrow morning.

sam: add to release notes: "Config-only: temporary pin of routing.policy to legacy on canary due to observed tail latency; lowered request.timeout_ms to 200ms; batching.window reverted. Follow-up: evaluate adaptive-v2 in a dedicated test cluster."

jordan: scheduling change window 09:00-11:00 PST tomorrow for prod rollout of conservative config. tagging infra and oncall.

maya: also creating a short postmortem-style note in the canary channel with latency plots and the commit that introduced adaptive-v2.

ops-runner: reminder to attach the canary trace IDs in the notes: trace: 0ff1ce-211223-zzzz

leo: thumbs if everyone ok with plan :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: will auto-unpin routing.policy in 29m unless extended. If latency regresses we can rollback config v2.3.11 with:
```bash
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service svc-inference --from-config v2.3.11 --to-config v2.3.10 --reason "latency regression in canary"
```

maya: thanks. keeping this thread as the single source for the decision and rollout notes.

leo: logging action items: 1) monitor p95 for 1h, 2) run diff-tests for adaptive-v2 in test cluster, 3) prepare release note and change-window playbook.

ops-runner: noted and assigning alerts to oncall.

sam: will draft release note and ping product for customer messaging if prod rollout changes.

deploy-bot: thread closed for now — reopen if new anomalies detected.
